newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev ends stable at 1,590-1,600 to dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev ends stable at 1,590-1,600 to dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 1,590-1,600 per dollar in brisk interbank trade, unchanged from the opening and from Thursday's close, as the central bank was seen as the main foreign currency buyer, traders said.
"The lev closed stable as banks and clients actively bid for levs to meet tax and wage payments due at end-month and end-quarter," said a commercial bank dealer.
Low dollar demand from commercial banks was compensated by central bank purchases in a pattern that has lasted throughout March, traders said.
BNB officials were not available for comment.
"The central bank has been increasing its foreign exchange reserves, capping a lev rise over 1,600 this month by its dollar buying," another dealer said.

Banks also opted for long lev positions to profit on high yield lev deposits during the weekend as markets in Western Europe and in the U.S are closed for Easter holidays. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
